name: Still water, 6 x 2 litre multipack
note: Three multipacks cover four people for three days and keep for two years.

name: Still water, 2 litre bottles
note: Any supermarket own brand is the same water; buy the shape that stacks.

name: Tinned fish, beans, fruit, oatcakes and nuts
note: Buy what you already eat, in sizes you will actually open.

name: Xtralite NiteSafe plug-in power-failure torch
note: Charges in the socket and switches on the instant the power drops.

name: NiteSafe Duo+ with motion sensor
note: The motion sensor makes it a night light the rest of the year.

name: Petzl Tikkina headtorch
note: The Hybrid version runs on AAA cells as well as the rechargeable core.

name: Ledlenser MH3 headtorch
note: Brighter and heavier; one for whoever goes outside.

name: Ugreen Nexode 25,000 mAh 145 W
note: Charges a phone four or five times and a laptop once.

name: Anker Laptop Power Bank 25K 165 W
note: The dearer option if you need to keep a laptop running.

name: Philips TAR1609 wind-up FM radio with torch
note: FM only, but it runs on AAAs, solar or the handle.

name: Roberts Play 20 DAB+ and FM on AA cells
note: Pair it with twelve lithium AA cells; the cells are the real backup.

name: Roberts SolarDAB 99 with crank, solar and USB-C
note: DAB+, FM, crank and solar in one weatherproof set.

name: Portable toilet bags with absorbent gel powder, pack of 30
note: Thirty bags is about two a person a day for a household of four over three days, so buy two packs if you want room to spare.

name: CarpLife Bivvy Loo refill pack: 12 liners, 12 powder sachets and 40 wipes
note: Liners, powder and wipes in one box, which is the whole job for two people for three days.

name: CarpLife Bivvy Loo absorbent powder, 1 kg
note: A kilogram of the powder alone, to go with strong bin bags you already have.

name: Mini UPS battery backup for routers, 10,400 mAh
note: Read the voltage on your router's own plug first and buy a unit that gives the same.

name: APC Back-UPS Connect CP12036LI 12 V mini UPS
note: Made for routers by the company that makes the office ones, for a router that takes 12 volts.

name: FireAngel FA6813 ten-year carbon monoxide alarm
note: Sealed battery, no maintenance for ten years.

name: Kidde FB1 fire blanket, 1.1 metre
note: Hang it by the cooker, not above it.

name: St John Ambulance home first-aid kit
note: Add two weeks of any prescription medicines yourself.

name: Tea lights, glass holders, lighters and matches
note: Jars stop a knocked candle becoming a fire.

name: Find an Arboricultural Association approved contractor
note: A survey is usually between one and two hundred and fifty pounds.

name: 12 V car inverter, 150 to 300 W
note: Enough to charge laptops and power banks from the car.

name: Air-brick covers, pack of four
note: Fit them before the warning, not during it.

name: Absorbent flood barrier sacks, pack of ten
note: Lighter than sandbags and they store flat.

name: 25 litre food-grade water carrier with tap
note: Four of these is a hundred litres; keep them dark and off concrete.

name: Aquatabs water purification tablets, 100
note: One tablet per 25 litres lets stored tap water keep a year.

name: WaterBOB emergency bath liner, 380 litres
note: Fills from the tap in twenty minutes when a warning comes.

name: 200 litre water butt with stand and diverter
note: For flushing and washing, never drinking untreated.

name: Tinned meat, fish, beans, vegetables, rice, pasta, oats and UHT milk
note: Build it by buying one extra of what you already eat each shop.

name: Campingaz Bistro 300 cartridge stove
note: About two hours per cartridge on full. Outside only.

name: Butane cartridges, 227 g, pack of four
note: Ten cartridges is a week of hot meals.

name: Long-reach refillable lighter
note: Keep it by the cooker.

name: Ledlenser ML4 lantern
note: One per occupied bedroom; forty-five hours on low.

name: Ledlenser ML6 lantern with power bank
note: For the living room; two hundred hours on low and it charges a phone.

name: Sentry 1210 thirty-minute fire box
note: Cash, passports, insurance, prescriptions and an encrypted memory stick.

name: Garden fire blanket, 1.8 metre
note: Hang it by the back door.

name: 30 metre hose with spray gun
note: It has to reach the back fence.

name: Bluetti Elite 100 V2, 1,024 Wh
note: The 1 kWh size, for a house that will fit rooftop solar with backup within a year.

name: Bluetti Elite 200 V2, 2,074 Wh
note: The 2 kWh size runs the fridge-freezer for fourteen hours.

name: EcoFlow 220 W bifacial folding solar panel
note: Tops up rather than sustains in a Welsh winter; recharges fully in a summer day.

name: British Berkefeld 6 litre gravity filter
note: Seventy litres a day from the water butt, a stream or rain.

name: Starlink Mini kit
note: About nine pounds a month on standby, fifty-five in a month you use it.
